text: 【外部扰动不改中国资本市场稳健本色】近期，受美债收益率持续走高、地缘风险扰动、全球流动性收紧预期等因素影响，国际资本市场震荡加剧。A股市场也是跌宕起伏，尤其是科技板块热点轮动加快。有经济学家在接受上海证券报记者采访时表示，近年来，伴随着中国经济结构持续优化、上市公司质量不断提升、投资者结构逐步改善和资本市场制度持续完善，支撑资本市场健康平稳运行的内在力量正在增强。
text_en: External disturbances do not alter the robust nature of China's capital markets: Recently, due to factors such as persistently rising US Treasury yields, geopolitical risk disturbances, and expectations of tighter global liquidity, international capital markets have experienced intensified volatility. The A-share market has also been turbulent, especially with faster rotation of hot spots in the tech sector. An economist said in an interview with a Shanghai Securities News reporter that in recent years, with the continuous optimization of China's economic structure, improving quality of listed companies, gradual improvement in investor structure, and ongoing refinement of capital market institutions, the internal forces supporting the healthy and stable operation of the market are strengthening.
